checked_items.zh: 检查了插件解析与使用的全部凭据读取面：DeepSeek 余额 Key、OpenCode Go Key、各 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK），以及 v1.7.13 新增的阿里云 RAM AccessKey/Secret/STS Token（lib/aliyun-balance.js:9-13）。每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点：DeepSeek 余额保留仅官方域名的端点守卫（lib/index.js:860-870），新增阿里云签名请求固定发往 business.aliyuncs.com（lib/aliyun-balance.js:8,97-107），密钥只用于在本地算签名、不出现在其他通道。
checked_items.en: Checked all credential read surfaces parsed and used by the plugin: DeepSeek balance Key, OpenCode Go Key, per-vendor Coding Plan Keys (including Volcano Ark AK/SK), and the newly added Alibaba Cloud RAM AccessKey/Secret/STS Token in v1.7.13 (lib/aliyun-balance.js:9-13). Each Key is only sent to the corresponding vendor's hardcoded official endpoint: the DeepSeek balance feature retains an endpoint guard restricted to the official domain (lib/index.js:860-870), the newly added Alibaba Cloud signed requests are fixed to business.aliyuncs.com (lib/aliyun-balance.js:8,97-107), and the secrets are only used to compute signatures locally and do not appear in other channels.

checked_items.zh: 检查了密钥写入与托管路径：预扫命中的凭据写入代码（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 @ lib/index.js:1919,2182,2246,2426 与 CHANGELOG.md:328）经逐处核对均为同一套托管机制——用户输入的密钥单向写入宿主凭据库、写入后清空配置遗留明文（lib/index.js:1919-1927），启动期迁移把账本遗留明文导入凭据库（lib/index.js:2174-2214），CHANGELOG 处为该机制的变更说明文字；新增阿里云凭据也走同一入口（lib/custom-balance.js:16,153）。读取侧只返回「已配置」状态、不返回值本身，良性排除。
checked_items.en: Checked secret storage and custody paths: the credentials written by pre-scan hits (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 @ lib/index.js:1919,2182,2246,2426 and CHANGELOG.md:328) were verified point by point to be the same custody mechanism — user-entered secrets are written one-way into the host credentials vault, and leftover plaintext in the config is cleared after writing (lib/index.js:1919-1927); startup migration imports leftover plaintext from the ledger into the credentials vault (lib/index.js:2174-2214); the CHANGELOG entry is descriptive text about changes to this mechanism; the newly added Alibaba Cloud credentials also go through the same entry point (lib/custom-balance.js:16,153). The read side only returns a "configured" status and never the value itself — benign, excluded.

checked_items.zh: 核对了全部直连出站端点：官方价格页、OpenCode Go 额度、各 Coding Plan 厂商端点均为硬编码官方域名（lib/index.js:636、lib/pricing.js:38-41、lib/coding-plans.js:943-976、lib/gateway-quota-adapters.js:154-211），权限声明列出 19 个域名（package.json:54-74）。v1.7.13 新增的阿里云余额端点 business.aliyuncs.com 已列入声明（package.json:73）。网关适配层内的上游厂商用量地址仅作为转发请求体经用户显式配置的 CLIProxyAPI 网关代发、令牌由网关侧替换（lib/gateway-quotas.js:424-444），插件不直连这些地址。

The Alibaba Cloud balance endpoint business.aliyuncs.com newly added in v1.7.13 is included in the declaration (package.json:73). Upstream vendor usage addresses within the gateway adapter layer are only sent as forwarded request bodies through the user-configured CLIProxyAPI gateway, with tokens replaced on the gateway side (lib/gateway-quotas.js:424-444); the plugin does not connect to these addresses directly.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 v1.7.13 新增的阿里云签名请求面：请求仅发往固定官方主机、凭据只参与本地签名、重定向一律拒绝（lib/aliyun-balance.js:35,104-111），响应体限 256 KiB 且不把上游账户身份信息下发浏览器（lib/aliyun-balance.js:14,80-95,116-118）；网关侧新增的重试仅针对暂态状态、最多一次并尊重服务端等待指示（lib/gateway-quotas.js:202-222,280-288,436-454），认证、策略、重定向类错误不重试。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the Alibaba Cloud signed request surface newly added in v1.7.13: requests go only to a fixed official host, credentials are only used for local signing, and redirects are always rejected (lib/aliyun-balance.js:35,104-111); response bodies are capped at 256 KiB and upstream account identity information is not sent down to the browser (lib/aliyun-balance.js:14,80-95,116-118); the newly added gateway-side retries only apply to transient statuses, occur at most once, and respect server wait indications (lib/gateway-quotas.js:202-222,280-288,436-454); auth, policy, and redirect-type errors are not retried.

No undeclared covert outbound connections were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载与安装面：挂载配置只插入服务声明行（cordis.patch.yml:4-6），不触碰安全相关配置行、无禁用或降权写法、未改写依赖注入/拦截配置；无安装期钩子；安装脚本与 CI 冒烟均固定到发布 tag（install.ps1:34-38、install-smoke.yml:52-56）。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch and install surfaces: the patch config only inserts a service declaration line (cordis.patch.yml:4-6), does not touch security-related config lines, has no disabling or privilege-lowering wording, and does not rewrite dependency injection/interception configs; no install-time hooks; both the install script and CI smoke are pinned to the release tag (install.ps1:34-38, install-smoke.yml:52-56).

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册：插件仅注册 llm/stream 计费监听（lib/index.js:2671-2686）、会话投影（lib/index.js:2689-2691）与 RPC 服务（lib/index.js:2694），未发现对审批、预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断监听（模式扫描零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked event listener registrations: the plugin only registers an llm/stream billing listener (lib/index.js:2671-2686), session projection (lib/index.js:2689-2691), and RPC services (lib/index.js:2694); no high-priority intercepting listeners on security events such as approval or pre-execution were found (pattern scan zero hits).

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的服务声明，未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，无禁用或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a service declaration with id cost-meter, does not override security rows such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no disabling or environment-variable privilege-lowering wording.

evidence.zh: 未发现以高优先级方式监听审批链等安全事件（模式扫描零命中）；计费监听为普通优先级且仅透传数据块（lib/index.js:2671-2686）。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on security events such as the approval chain were found (pattern scan zero hits); the billing listener runs at normal priority and only passes data chunks through (lib/index.js:2671-2686).

evidence.zh: 与基线 1.7.10@e9cafb51 对比，manifest 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明形态未变（仍为挂载配置 + web 客户端，package.json:19-21）；v1.7.12 新增的兼容性声明块仅逐版本记录兼容状态、非能力声明（package.json:22-29），无升级自动激活突变。
evidence.en: Compared with baseline 1.7.10@e9cafb51, the manifest's dsh.bundle/dsh.client declaration shape is unchanged (still patch config + web client, package.json:19-21); the compatibility declaration block newly added in v1.7.12 only records compatibility status per version, not capability declarations (package.json:22-29); no mutation that auto-activates on upgrade.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写依赖注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite dependency injection/interception configs; there is no tamper surface that appends required services to security plugins causing them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口：未发现；插件只通过宿主 RPC 提供服务（lib/index.js:2694），客户端仅有同源只读状态探测（src/client/02-validators-helpers-sidebar.js:2306），不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin sets up its own listener service or web port: none found; the plugin only provides services through host RPC (lib/index.js:2694), and the client has only a same-origin read-only status probe (src/client/02-validators-helpers-sidebar.js:2306); it does not listen on any port itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Noted ecosystem-inherent risk: the host's local RPC lacking an authentication layer is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself does not expand that risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧固有风险已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web service or listening port, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable; the host-side inherent risk is noted in the dimension description.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：dsh 声明齐全、依赖精确锁版、版本五处引用对齐（发版脚本设有对齐检查），名称与作者一致，无仿冒或异常身份信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: dsh declarations complete, dependencies exactly pinned, version references consistent across five locations (the release script includes a consistency check), name and author consistent; no impersonation or anomalous identity signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：17 条预扫命中逐条裁决为良性——DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 开发与测试工具的子进程导入与源码切片动态求值 6 处、DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 凭据托管写入与变更日志 5 处、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 演示页长行与压缩产物 4 处、DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 CI 工作流 1 处、DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 维护者指令文件 1 处；运行时源码未发现危险执行模式。
summary.en: Static scan complete: all 17 pre-scan hits adjudicated as benign — DSH-X03/DG-R3-55: 6 occurrences of subprocess imports and dynamic evaluation of source slices in dev/test tooling; DSH-X05/DG-R3-57: 5 occurrences of credential custody writes and the changelog; DSH-X08/DG-R3-60: 4 occurrences of demo-page long lines and minified artifacts; DSH-X07/DG-R3-59: 1 CI workflow; DSH-X10/DG-R2-57: 1 maintainer instruction file; no dangerous execution patterns found in runtime sources.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装期钩子、无混淆载荷；密钥单向进入宿主凭据库、新增阿里云凭据仅参与本地签名且发往固定官方端点，直连出站均为声明内官方域名，网关重试有界且不触碰副作用端点硬闸。
summary.en: Behavioral analysis passed: no install-time hooks, no obfuscated payloads; secrets flow one-way into the host credentials vault, the newly added Alibaba Cloud credentials participate only in local signing and go to fixed official endpoints, all direct outbound traffic is within declared official domains, and gateway retries are bounded and do not touch side-effect endpoints subject to the hard gate.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：服务描述、提示文案、价目同步提示词文档与维护者指令文件均未发现注入或诱导措辞，模型上下文改写类接缝零接入。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: service descriptions, prompt texts, the pricing sync prompt document, and the maintainer instruction file contain no injection or solicitation wording; no model context rewrite seams are tapped.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase (no dynamic sandbox artifacts provided).

declared_unobserved.en: ax.ac.sugon.com in the permission declaration (Supercomputing Internet SCNet): the code only references its documentation address in a comment (lib/coding-plans.js:736); the domain is absent from the official endpoint table (lib/coding-plans.js:943-976), and quota is computed via local Credits conversion — a conservative over-declaration, no risk.

declared_unobserved.en: platform.qianwenai.com and platform-home.qianwenai.com in the permission declaration (Qwen Token Plan): carried over from the previous version's review conclusion (this module is not in the change surface of this release); Qwen Token Plan quota is metered locally and the code makes no outbound calls to these two domains; the balance query newly added in v1.7.13 goes to business.aliyuncs.com (declared) — a conservative over-declaration, no risk.

target.en: dsh-cost-meter@1.7.13#0e09b701e073c2a7f6c2cdad28f33266ef6f544f (repo-root plugin, full-tree audit; baseline from previous report 1.7.10@e9cafb51)

limits.zh: 动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用，未提供动态沙箱产物，未做动态验证。test/verify.mjs 约 47 万字节、超过单文件读取上限，采取机器预扫命中行定位与分段抽读相结合的方式核查（命中行均为客户端源码切片的单元测试求值与模块环子进程回归，读取助手与编译门禁位于 test/verify.mjs:94-107），未逐字通读全文。pnpm-lock.yaml 与 docs 下大量截图、发布说明未逐字通读，按清单与关键段核对。声明能力沿用上版口径（dsh.bundle 未含能力字段，按代码实测与 dshhub 元数据推断）。v1.7.13 新增的阿里云余额查询与网关重试面以静态审查为准，其运行时交互未经动态验证；审计预算在覆盖全部预扫命中点与核心运行时模块后耗尽，docs 其余文档仅按需抽查。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) was not enabled; no dynamic sandbox artifacts were provided and no dynamic verification was performed. test/verify.mjs is about 470 KB, exceeding the single-file read limit, so it was reviewed via a combination of machine pre-scan hit-line locating and segmented spot reading (hit lines are all unit-test evaluations of client source slices and a module-cycle subprocess regression; the read helper and compilation gate are at test/verify.mjs:94-107); the full text was not read verbatim. pnpm-lock.yaml and the many screenshots and release notes under docs were not read verbatim; they were checked against manifests and key sections. Declared capabilities follow the previous version's convention (dsh.bundle contains no capability fields; inferred from code inspection and dshhub metadata). The Alibaba Cloud balance query and gateway retry surface newly added in v1.7.13 were reviewed statically; their runtime interactions were not dynamically verified. The audit budget was exhausted after covering all pre-scan hit points and core runtime modules; remaining docs were only spot-checked as needed.
